description: This file implements cgroup management for the 'cpuset' subsystem, including functions for setting, retrieving, and ensuring cpuset configurations within Linux cgroups, with specific handling for the v1 cpuset cgroup.

classes.name: CpusetGroup
classes.description: Represents the cpuset cgroup controller, providing methods to apply configurations, set parameters, and retrieve statistics.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the cgroup controller, 'cpuset'.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies the resource constraints to the specified cgroup path for a given process ID.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets cpuset parameters such as cpus and mems for the specified cgroup path.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Retrieves various cpuset statistics and parameters from the cgroup.

methods.name: ApplyDir
methods.description: Creates and configures a cgroup directory with specified resources and moves a process into it.

methods.name: ensureCpusAndMems
methods.description: Ensures cpus and mems are set correctly in the cgroup directory.
